title: CakePHP AI
description: Unified API for 17 AI providers: agents with tools and sub-agents, structured output, images, audio, transcription, embeddings with reranking, streaming, queueing and broadcasting.
name: Ai

title: AiInteraction
description: UI-agnostic interaction primitives: turn runner, slash commands, sessions with titles, input history, per-user preferences and a response-stop contract.
name: AiInteraction

title: AiTui
description: Fastest way in: terminal chat with any agent via a single ai chat command — key bindings, input recall and tool-call cards on AiInteraction turns.
name: AiTui

title: AiNexus
description: Web dashboard and playground for agents: discovery, streaming chat, attachments and retention. Early stage — configuration reference only for now.
name: AiNexus

title: Panifex
description: CakePHP harness for coding agents: autonomous runs, terminal UI, web chat-ops and other channels, plus 14 agent variants, 35 tools, guards and healing.
name: Panifex

title: MCP
description: Model Context Protocol servers and clients for CakePHP: tools, resources, and prompts over HTTP or STDIO, OAuth via Tessera, and interactive MCP Apps.
name: Mcp
